name: Park Hyatt Beaver Creek Resort and Spa
insider_take: This alpine sanctuary sits at 8,100 feet elevation, making it one of the highest luxury resorts in North America, where rarefied mountain air meets world-class sophistication.
whats_special: The resort features the only ski-in, ski-out access to Beaver Creek's legendary Grouse Mountain Express lift, plus Colorado's largest resort spa at 30,000 square feet. The property's stone and timber architecture seamlessly blends with the surrounding Vail Valley landscape, while its location in Beaver Creek Village puts you steps from some of the region's most exclusive boutiques and galleries.
pro_tip: Book treatments at Allegria Spa before 10am or after 4pm to snag the best appointment times and avoid the post-ski rush – plus you'll get stunning mountain views during golden hour.
dont_miss: The weekly Beaver Creek Wine & Spirit Festival during summer months, held right in the village plaza. Winter visitors should experience the complimentary fresh-baked cookies and hot cocoa served slopeside every afternoon at 3pm – a beloved Beaver Creek tradition for over 40 years.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location at Beaver Creek Mountain
Luxury spa with mountain-inspired treatments and wellness facilities
Elegant alpine architecture with sophisticated Rocky Mountain design
Exclusive Hyatt PRIVÉ benefits including VIP amenities and personalized service
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury mountain resort positioning
Seasonal availability with peak winter rates during ski season
